positive_snippets:
We had a truly wonderful stay from start to finish. Everything was seamless and well taken care of, making our experience incredibly comfortable. The rooms were spotless, spacious, and thoughtfully designed.

The staff were warm, attentive, and always ready to help, which made us feel genuinely welcomed. The central location was perfect—easy access to the city while still offering a calm and relaxing atmosphere.

The food was delicious with great variety and quality. Overall, it was a memorable experience that perfectly balanced comfort, convenience, and exceptional hospitality. We would happily choose this place again and highly recommend it.

Had a really pleasant stay here. The ambience is beautiful and well-maintained, giving a calm and comfortable vibe throughout. Rooms are clean, spacious, and thoughtfully designed. Room service is quick and polite, and the overall hospitality feels professional yet warm. Everything from cleanliness to comfort is handled well, making it a great choice for family stays, work trips, or a relaxing break. Definitely a place I’d recommend and visit again.

I stayed at this hotel under Air India accommodation guarantee due to flight schedule issues.
The room was very clean, the hot shower worked well, and the hospitality was good.
If they could add more Western options to the breakfast menu, it would be even better.
negative_snippets:
would strongly advise others not to stay at this hotel.

My flight was delayed and Air India arranged this hotel for me, but unfortunately the experience was very disappointing. The room curtains were damaged, and the biggest issue was the smell. The windows are locked in all the rooms, so there is absolutely no air circulation. The room had a very strong, unpleasant odor that made it extremely uncomfortable to stay there .. it made me nauseous and i was puking .

Almost every guest I spoke to was complaining about the same issues. There were very limited food options as well .. only two or three items were available, and there was no flexibility.

The only positive aspect of this hotel was the customer service staff, who were polite and doing their best. However, overall the stay was not pleasant, and I would not recommend this hotel to anyone.

Never rely on them for any marriage or family function. They ruined the wedding day for my friend’s marriage. We booked 4 rooms for 2 days and gave more than 70% of amount on day 1 itself. When the guests arrived they told them they gave out 2 rooms as they were asked to release 2 rooms by giving my name. I had to reach the hotel leaving the sangeet night and then they said they released those because the didn’t receive the full payment in advance. I scolded them hard but all in vain, had to look for rooms at mid night for the guests. Such a pathetic experience.
